Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

easyRaschBayes (development version)

  • Bug fix - q3_statistic(), q3_statistic_hpcm(), plot_residual_pca() and item_restscore_statistic() now stop with an error if a person x item combination occurs more than once in the model data. Previously only the last response of each duplicated combination was kept, without warning. Results for data with one response per person and item are unchanged.
  • Breaking - plot_targeting() follows easyRasch2::RMtargeting(). The bottom panel now shows response-category bands (panel = "categories"), with red marks for categories that are never most likely and for reversed thresholds, labelled with their posterior probabilities. New arguments panel, person_estimate (EAP default, or WLE), xlim, category_labels, viridis_*, row_gap and output = "list", which also returns the posterior category tables. Defaults for bins and the x-axis follow RMtargeting, prob = NULL hides intervals, and sort_items = "location" now puts the easiest item at the top. ‘scales’ is added to Imports.
  • Breaking - item_restscore_statistic() now conditions on the total score. It adds Kreiner’s expected gamma (gamma_exp), replicates data given each person’s total score, uses a mid-p ppp and adds a max-T ppp_adj. gamma_diff is now observed minus expected. The zero-width gamma_obs_q* columns are replaced by gamma_rep_q*. Only Rasch-family models (bernoulli, acat, logit, no disc) are accepted. Results change. item_restscore_post() follows the new output and accepts any item column name.
  • Breaking - infit_statistic() gains method = c("conditional", "theta"). The default now computes conditional infit given the total score, matching iarm::out_infit() for the same item parameters, and replicates data given each person’s total score. Only Rasch-family models are accepted. method = "theta" gives the 0.3.0 results.
  • Breaking - infit_post() infit_ppp is now P(observed > replicated) with mid-p ties, so values near 1 indicate underfit, as in q3_post(). infit_post() accepts any item column name.
  • New datasets phq9, the same PHQ-9 data as in easyRasch2 (600 NHANES respondents, nine items with four categories), and phq9_nhanes, a random sample of 1000 NHANES PHQ-9 respondents with the zero responses of a general population sample, for the hurdle partial credit model.
  • plot_icc() gains method ("quantile", "width", "score", "manual") and score_breaks, as in easyRasch2’s RMitemICCPlot(). n_intervals is renamed class_intervals in plot_icc() and plot_icc_hpcm() (the old name still works, with a deprecation warning). A caption states the grouping used, also when tied sum scores give fewer quantile groups than requested.
  • plot_icc_hpcm() severity panel adds the model-expected mean for the same responses in each class interval (orange diamonds). Binning on shrunk EAPs had made the observed points look misfitting.
  • plot_icc() with dif_var distinguishes groups by shape and line type as well as colour.
  • plot_targeting_hpcm() leaves persons who answered 0 on every item out of the severity histogram, with a caption.
  • plot_targeting() labels a category collapse caused by a threshold reversal once, on the reversal arrow, and spaces rows more widely, so labels no longer overlap when many items have reversed thresholds.
  • Docs - infit_statistic() and infit_post() state that the infit ppp is conservative, also with the conditional method, and suggest also using item_restscore_statistic().
  • Bug fix - dif_statistic() for polytomous models loaded any difference in group latent means onto every item as DIF, and the uniform DIF parameter was not identified. Both types now estimate impact separately (new impact element) with DIF relative to the average item. Uniform DIF uses item random slopes of a group indicator. All types share one sign: positive = easier for the focal (second) group. Item labels that brms renames no longer give silent zeros. Results change for polytomous models.
  • Bug fix - rating scale models (acat with (1 | item) and common thresholds) gave every item the same thresholds, and 0 + item models failed in plot_residual_pca() and plot_targeting(). All functions now share one item parameter extractor. Results change for rating scale models.
  • Bug fix - person_parameters() and person_parameters_hpcm() gave persons with missing responses the full-test WLE for their sum score. The WLE now uses the items each person answered, and a new n_items column counts them. score_table covers persons who answered every item.
  • Bug fix - person_parameters() and plot_icc() counted ordinal sum scores from the lowest category observed in the data, not from category 1, which shifted all scores when nobody used category 1.
  • Bug fix - plot_icc() partial gamma used the wrong column for numeric item labels.
  • Bug fix - plot_residual_pca() aligned eigenvector signs across draws by counting signs, which could pull a small group of strongly loading items toward zero. Signs now follow the dot product with the mean direction.
  • Bug fix - posterior_epred() for hurdle_acat failed when items had different numbers of categories.
  • Bug fix - plot_ipf() and plot_icc() always used the logistic curve. They now use the model’s link for cumulative, sratio and cratio models, and stop for non-logit acat models and models that estimate disc.
  • Bug fix - infit_statistic_hpcm() and q3_statistic_hpcm() failed with ordered-factor responses or a single draw. plot_icc_hpcm() no longer shifts responses down when there are no zeros. Hurdle item parameters are found for labels that brms renames.
  • plot_icc(), plot_icc_hpcm() (hurdle panel) and plot_residual_pca() now report how many persons with missing responses they leave out.
  • item_parameters() n_eff is now posterior::ess_bulk(), which accounts for disagreement between chains. ‘posterior’ is added to Imports.
  • plot_tile() and plot_stackedbars() use theme_bw(). The plot_stackedbars() legend now runs lowest to highest from the top. plot_ipf() adds line types to the category colours.
  • Docs - corrected RMUreliability() return value, the plot_residual_pca() style default and centring, the plot_icc() partial gamma sign, and added caveats to posterior_to_prior() (independent priors) and plot_icc_hpcm() (EAP binning).
  • Bug fix - infit_post() infit_ppp and q3_post() q3_ppp compared each draw’s observed value with the mean of the replicated values, not with the replicated value of the same draw. Results change.
  • Docs - infit_statistic_hpcm() is no longer described as conditional infit. The hdi tables of infit_post() and q3_post() are described as exceedance proportions. Results are unchanged.

easyRaschBayes 0.3.0

CRAN release: 2026-06-18

  • New custom brms family hurdle_acat for hurdle partial credit models (H-PCM). This is written by Kristoffer Magnusson
  • Several adapted (experimental) functions for H-PCM, all using the *_hpcm suffix.
    • infit_statistic_hpcm()
    • q3_statistic_hpcm()
    • item_parameters_hpcm()
    • person_parameters_hpcm()
    • RMUreliability_hpcm()
    • plot_icc_hpcm()
    • plot_targeting_hpcm()
  • Bug fix - changed post processing functions to use median_hdci() instead of median_hdi() to avoid issues with multimodal posteriors.
  • Bug fix - corrected the WLE person estimates in person_parameters() and person_parameters_hpcm(). The polytomous Warm bias correction had the wrong sign, biasing estimates outward; WLE now matches catR/TAM. Extreme (minimum and maximum) scores now receive proper finite WLE estimates instead of being clamped to the theta_range bounds.

easyRaschBayes 0.2.0.1

CRAN release: 2026-04-23

  • Fix for plot_icc() theta values.

easyRaschBayes 0.2.0

CRAN release: 2026-03-28

  • Updates:
    • infit_statistic() is now faster and defaults to not output outfit statistics, since these are of dubious value (see Müller 2020 and Johansson, 2025).
    • item_restscore_statistic() is now faster and has output similar to infit_post().
    • q3_statistic() is now faster and has output similar to infit_post().
    • plot_residual_pca() is now faster.
  • Three post-processing helper functions that output a list with result table(s) and a plot:
    • infit_post() for the output of infit_statistic()
    • item_restscore_post() for the output of item_restscore_statistic()
    • q3_post() for the output of q3_statistic()
  • Other new functions:
    • plot_icc() can both produce a basic conditional Item Characteristic Curves plot and optionally a DIF ICC plot, the latter also reporting a partial gamma DIF magnitude coefficient. This is inspired by iarm::ICCplot()
    • item_parameters() to retrieve item threshold locations
    • person_parameters() to retrieve person locations (latent scores) using EAP and WLE, and also a transformation table from ordinal sum score to EAP/WLE.
    • posterior_to_prior() that extracts priors from a brmsfit model that may be useful in model fit assessment. An article will be added later, exploring this further.
    • plot_tile(), plot_bars(), and plot_stackedbars() uses wide format item data to create plots to review response patterns.
